topics.label: Course and Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the final lecture of the course and outlines its learning objectives regarding cancer therapy approaches.

topics.label: Conventional Non-Targeted Cancer Therapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine traditional non-targeted cancer therapies and the challenges of balancing tumor clearance with systemic toxicity.

topics.label: Targeting Intrinsic Cancer Cell Vulnerabilities
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain therapeutic strategies that selectively exploit intrinsic physiological and genetic vulnerabilities of cancer cells.

topics.label: Oncogene Addiction and Kinase Inhibitors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how oncogene addiction is therapeutically exploited using kinase inhibitors and the mechanisms by which tumors develop resistance to these targeted therapies.

topics.label: Monoclonal Antibodies and Antibody-Drug Conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the use of targeted monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates directed against tumor-associated surface antigens.

topics.label: Tumor Immune Surveillance and Checkpoint Blockade
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the body's natural immune response to tumors and the reactivation of exhausted T cells through immune checkpoint blockade.

topics.label: Engineered Cellular Immunotherapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe engineered immunotherapies that redirect cytotoxic T cells to target cancer cells, highlighting bispecific engagers and CAR T-cell technologies.

topics.label: Challenges, Progress, and Future Directions in Cancer Management
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics reflect on the overarching challenges, historical survival trends, and future directions in cancer management.
